model.title: CIPZIP Act of 2025
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee · Sen. James Lankford (R-OK)

summary.text: The bill would establish a pilot program allowing certain ZIP Code boundaries to be changed on an experimental basis. It aims to test whether adjusting these postal boundaries could improve mail delivery efficiency or address other operational concerns in participating areas.
